    Everything runs in your browser; files are never uploaded.
    
  
    Works offline after your first visit.
    
  
    Bundled libraries: pdf.js, Tesseract.js and its Fast and Best language models (Apache-2.0), libheif (LGPL-3.0, shipped unmodified), Mediabunny (MPL-2.0); for metadata, exifr, piexif, pdf-lib, opentype.js and browser-id3-writer (MIT) and jsmediatags (BSD-3-Clause). Each loads only when needed. Details in vendor/README.md.
    
  
    Keyboard
    
  
  
    
    
    1–9
    Open an outcome card
    
    
    ← →
    Previous or next PDF page
    
    
    Ctrl/⌘ V
    Paste a hash to verify the file
    
    
    ↑ ↓ Enter
    Move through the tray, open a file
    
    
    Esc
    Back to the file or the tray
    
    
    Delete
    Remove a tray file, a page or a box
    
    
    Space R Shift+←→
    Pages: select, rotate, move
    
    
    Ctrl/⌘ A
    Select every page
    
    
    ←↑↓→
    Redact: nudge the selected box
    
    
    Ctrl/⌘ Z
    Undo in Pages and Redact
